name: cognition/recall-engrams
description: Query a persona's admitted-engram store. Modes: 'recent' (default) returns newest-first N engrams; 'by_id' looks up by exact engram id; 'by_keyword' does case-insensitive substring match; 'by_origin' filters by EngramOriginKind (chat | airc | tool | self_reflection). Wraps the Rust IPC handler shipped in #1121 PR-5.

params.name: personaId
params.description: UUID of the persona whose engram store to query

params.name: limit
params.description: Max engrams to return (default: 10). Ignored when kind='by_id'.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Substring to match against engram content (required when kind='by_keyword')

results.name: engrams
results.description: Matching engrams (typed as Engram in shared/generated/persona/Engram.ts)

examples.description: Recall the 5 most recent engrams during rag/build
